text:
Maya Rao: Thanks everyone for coming — quick capture from the Q&A and live thread. Recording + slides: https://redwood.example.com/allhands/3076543210 :link:

Maya Rao: TL;DR answers we promised: Dedicated GA target = Q3 (more precise dates below), Private pilot = select customers by EOY (VPC + on-prem options), pricing tiers and SLA draft in flight. I'll leave open asks here so owners can confirm.

Sanjay Patel: Quick perf question from infra folks — are the kernel optimizations going to be in the hosted runtime at GA or post-GA?

Maya Rao: @Sanjay kernel selection improvements will be in the GA runtime but some advanced ops will land as minor patch releases during Q3. We'll publish a compatibility matrix.

Kristin Lee: Re pricing — I'll own the pricing tier proposal. Planning to post a PRD + example rate cards by next Wed (link to PRD when ready).

Dario Gomez: Ops/SRE follow-up: SLA targets? Want numbers to test against.

Maya Rao: @Dario working draft: 99.9% uptime for Dedicated with credits for maintenance windows; 95th/50th latency SLOs per model class. @Dario can you draft formal wording and escalation path?

Dario Gomez: Yep — I'll drop a doc in #eng-sre and link back here. ETA Mon COB.

Ezra Chen: Action for Research/ML: we promised model-regression eval sets for customers upgrading models. I'll collate the initial benchmark set and publish a how-to. ETA Fri.

Sanjay Patel: For Dedicated capacity — can customers pin GPUs to specific racks? Is that part of Dedicated or Private only?

Maya Rao: Rack pinning = Private-only (on-prem/VPC), Dedicated will have placement controls but not physical rack pinning at GA.

Kristin Lee: Quick ask from sales — any guidance on ramp discounts for committed capacity?

Maya Rao: We'll have committed-usage tiers (monthly/annual) with sliding discounts; @Kristin to include examples in PRD.

Sanjay Patel: Follow-up: Quantization recommendations — who owns the perf/quality tradeoff docs?

Ezra Chen: I'll partner with @Sanjay to produce a short playbook: recommended quant configs per model family and expected latency/cost delta. Will include small eval harness.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: New doc created: https://notion.redwood/ops/sla-draft (created by Dario Gomez) :white_check_mark:

Maya Rao: Action list (owners):
- Kristin Lee: Pricing PRD + sample rate cards (ETA next Wed)
- Dario Gomez: SLA wording + escalation + runbook (ETA Mon COB)
- Ezra Chen: Regression eval sets + quant playbook (ETA Fri)
- Sanjay Patel: Kernel/perf compatibility matrix (ETA next Thu)
- Maya Rao: Consolidate answers and publish consolidated all-hands Q&A doc (ETA EOD Monday)

Kristin Lee: I'll also add a short FAQ for sales with dos/don'ts for Early Access customers.

Sanjay Patel: Noted — I'll add a short list of known limitations for the GA runtime to the matrix.

Ezra Chen: For the regression evals — can we get a volunteer customer for pilot? @Kristin any early customers open to this?

Kristin Lee: Yes — there's one mid-market customer who asked specifically. I'll intro privately and loop you in.

Maya Rao: Two quick clarifications from the live Q:
1) Private pilot scope = VPC + optional on-prem package for a small set of pilot customers, not full enterprise rollouts.
2) Dedicated GA will ship with model-variant fallbacks for capacity shortages.

Dario Gomez: FYI I'll include a short canary checklist in the runbook:
```
canary steps:
- route 1% traffic to new runtime
- monitor 95th latency, error-rate
- rollback on >0.5% increase in request errors
```

Maya Rao: If any owners need to adjust ETAs, ping me here. I'll keep thread open and will freeze the consolidated doc at EOD Monday. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
